Diplomat.name: Diplomat
Diplomat.description: The Diplomat is a master of negotiation and alliance-building. They excel in forming strategic partnerships and can sway other factions to their cause.

Spy.name: Spy
Spy.description: The Spy is a covert operative skilled in gathering intelligence and conducting espionage. They can infiltrate enemy lines and uncover critical information.

Scientist.name: Scientist
Scientist.description: The Scientist is a brilliant mind, capable of conducting research and developing new technologies. They can unlock advanced capabilities for their faction.

Explorer.name: Explorer
Explorer.description: The Explorer is an intrepid adventurer, skilled in navigating uncharted territories and discovering new worlds. They can lead expeditions and uncover valuable resources.

Commando.name: Commando
Commando.description: The Commando is a highly trained soldier, adept at executing precision strikes and special operations. They excel in combat and can lead elite units into battle.

Firebrand.name: Firebrand
Firebrand.description: The Firebrand is a master of subversive activities, skilled in inciting rebellion and destabilizing enemy regimes. They can ignite resistance movements and create chaos in hostile territories.

Partisan.name: Partisan
Partisan.description: The Partisan is a resistance fighter, skilled in guerrilla warfare and sabotage. They can strike at enemy infrastructure and disrupt their operations.

Commander.name: Commander
Commander.description: The Commander is a tactical genius, leading fighters into space battles

General.name: General
General.description: The General is a master strategist, capable of leading large-scale planetary operations and coordinating multiple units in battle.

Admiral.name: Admiral
Admiral.description: The Admiral is a seasoned naval officer, commanding fleets of starships and orchestrating space battles with precision.
